help zynqmp
zynqmp - ZynqMP sub-system

Usage:
zynqmp secure src len [key_addr] - verifies secure images of $len bytes
                            long at address $src. Optional key_addr
                            can be specified if user key needs to
                            be used for decryption
zynqmp mmio_read address - read from address
zynqmp mmio_write address mask value - write value after masking to
					address
zynqmp aes srcaddr ivaddr len aesop keysrc dstaddr [keyaddr]
	Encrypts or decrypts blob of data at src address and puts it
	back to dstaddr using key and iv at keyaddr and ivaddr
	respectively. keysrc value specifies from which source key
	has to be used, it can be User/Device/PUF key. A value of 0
	for KUP(user key),1 for DeviceKey and 2 for PUF key. The
	aesop value specifies the operation which can be 0 for
	decrypt and 1 for encrypt operation
zynqmp tcminit mode - Initialize the TCM with zeros. TCM needs to be
		       initialized before accessing to avoid ECC
		       errors. mode specifies in which mode TCM has
		       to be initialized. Supported modes will be
		       lock(0)/split(1)
zynqmp rsa srcaddr srclen mod exp rsaop
	Performs RSA encryption and RSA decryption on blob of data
	at srcaddr and puts it back in srcaddr using modulus and
	public or private exponent
	srclen : must be key size(4096 bits)
	exp :	private key exponent for RSA decryption(4096 bits)
		public key exponent for RSA encryption(32 bits)
	rsaop :	0 for RSA Decryption, 1 for RSA Encryption
zynqmp sha3 srcaddr srclen [key_addr]
	Generates sha3 hash value for data blob at srcaddr and puts
	48 bytes hash value into srcaddr
	Optional key_addr can be specified for saving sha3 hash value
	Note: srcaddr/srclen should not be 0
